title: The Ten Bands of Power
tagline: Every creature in Skyrim has a fixed place. The world no longer grows with you — you grow into it.

bands.name: Trained
bands.who: Most bandits, low-level soldiers and guards, novice mages

bands.name: Blooded
bands.who: Low-level Forsworn, fort bandits, low-level draugr, apprentice mages, most soldiers and guards, low-level Falmer, ghosts

bands.name: Experienced
bands.who: Forsworn, guard and soldier captains, adept mages, Falmer, draugr, bandit chiefs, witches and hags, low-level vampires, regular Thalmor soldiers, Dwarven spiders, Vigilants, the Silver Hand

bands.name: Elite
bands.who: Thalmor Justiciars, Penitus Oculatus, Dark Brotherhood and Morag Tong assassins, Forsworn Briarhearts, draugr Deathlords, Falmer Shadowmasters and Warmongers, Dwarven spheres and ballistas, expert mages, the Dawnguard

bands.name: Powerful
bands.who: Dwarven centurions, werewolves, vampires, lesser Daedra (Seekers, Dremora, Saints and Seducers), most lesser named bosses

bands.name: Fabled
bands.who: Named Dragon Priests, vampire lords, named Daedra, low-level dragons

bands.name: Mythic
bands.who: Dragons, greater Daedra, Harkon, the Ebony Warrior
